_about: Static-analysis hook map for capturing JSON key->class leaks via Newtonsoft.Json deserialisation. See JSON_HOOK_DESIGN.md.

newtonsoft_core_hooks.why: PRIME HOOK. Called once per JSON property. Args carry the JsonProperty (-> get_UnderlyingName = the real field name) and the target object being filled (-> its il2cpp class). One hook = (key, target_class) for every DTO.
